div.div: The person logs out while a refresh may be running. The app first blocks new refreshes, waits for the one in flight, asks the backend to revoke the token and only then clears local storage, so a late refresh cannot bring the session back to life.

div.div:
Logical RPC arrows show the caller awaiting a correlated RabbitMQ response; transport envelopes are abstracted.
No payment/call/notification interaction expanded; mandatory gateway completion is abstracted in a ref.
An error while clearing local storage still reaches endLogout in finally.
